decisions.reason: Because this award-winning geothermal probe was publicly highlighted on its own page and fits the firm's core solutions strategy, management is very likely to defend the investment and keep it.
As a related geothermal extension with visible launch commitment but no clear proof of failure, management can justify continued support and attribute any weak uptake to temporary factors.
This geothermal surface-technology line spans several models, implying broader investment and portfolio commitment that escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to reverse.

A fire-protection steel profile system is close to the established building-systems business, so sunk development and marketing effort plus strategic fit make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
Although a slim steel profile system could be rationalized if demand disappoints, its closeness to the core range and the firm's public introduction still make management more likely to keep it.

This decorative surface system is somewhat easier to drop than the more functional innovations, but the firm's prior public commitment and modest extension of the existing portfolio still favor keeping it.
